methodology: Weekly individual game statistics, not cumulative season totals; top five QB by gross passing yards, RB by rushing yards, WR and TE separately by receiving yards. Positions verified using ESPN 2026 rosters/athlete profiles. Upsets are outright wins by underdogs using stored verified closing markets or separately identified Last Verified grading markets; ties, pick-em, favorite wins and cover-only results excluded. Market gaps disclosed. Recaps reuse saved verified box scores without claiming unsupported causes.
